[[Aaron Fletcher]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for armor. He and his wife [[Jaden Fletcher|Jaden]] gather Ancient Eyes in the Maguuma Jungle for use as armor components.
